segments.text: Classmates were surprised to find out that Kanae is not a boy, but a lovely and polite girl. However, you'd better not to anger her, because she could easily turn into Mako.
和服がよく似合う大和撫子な少女。
昔は、祖母の言いつけで男として学園に通っていたが、今では普通の女の子として通っている。
「どうせ水越さんと楽しんでいるんでしょ……」

She is a very eccentric-looking girl. Her name, age and nationality are all unknown. However, she seems to be looking for something so she prowls around the village. Contrary to her appearance, she acts very maturely. However, sometimes anachronisms show up in her conversation. For some reason, $1.00 equals 360 Yen in her mind. She also has an unbelievably huge appetite and even grills her favorite, corn on a cob, to enjoy by herself. She can always be found holding her stuffed animal, the cat "Archimedes".
Hobbies: Grilling corn, hanging Teru teru bozus (good luck charms for good weather)
Likes: Grilled corn, steamed rice, old love songs
Dislikes: Rain, fireworks (because they disappear too quickly)
Basic Behavior: Although she acts mature, she can be childish at times. She is always curious and hungry so she can easily be lured.
Edited from MangaGamer
神社の軒先で寝泊まりしていたのを、不憫に思い拾われてきた少女。
何かを探しているらしいのだが、探し物も自分の名前も忘れているために「お嬢」と呼ばれることになる。
とにかく大食らいだったり、すぐに姿を消したり、人の言葉を理解する猫のぬいぐるみ（アルキメデス）を持っていたりと、とにかく謎の少女。
エキセントリックな容姿の女の子。
国籍も年齢も名前も不明。
何か探しモノがあるらしく、村中をうろついている。
外見に似合わぬ大人びた言動なのだが、
時折、時代錯誤した会話をすることもある。
彼女の中では１ドル３６０円らしい。
信じられないくらい大飯ぐらいで、
大好物の焼とうもろこしは、
自分で七輪で焼いて食べていることもある。
腕に抱くのは、
相棒のぬいぐるみ“アルキメデス”くん。
腹話術（？）なのか会話もできる。

segments.text: Sayaka is a fine young lady often misunderstood, ignored and hated by the villagers of Tokiwa because of her father, Ritsu-sensei, who is an eccentric painter that excels in the art of "Death". His passion for painting has also passed unto Sayaka. The painting world became a sanctuary for Sayaka and she is often seen painting at her family's art studio together with her only trusted friend Kamishiro Souji. Despite her seniority over Souji, she sometimes acts like his junior even to the point of asking him to be her tutor. When she feels tired or has nothing else to do, she is always seen taking a nap in the hammock near her house.
Hobbies: Painting, naps (in a hammock)
Likes: Pumpkins, scarecrows (strange ones), long phone conversations
Basic Behavior: She is honest to herself, gets angry easily, and overreacts to things.
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough
第二章登場のヒロイン。
死をテーマに絵を描く父親を持つために、村で孤立している少女。
そんな彼女は、持ち前の明るさで今日も元気に昼寝と散歩を繰り返していた。
だがこの夏、さすがに落第のピンチを迎えたさやかは、学園と美術講の後輩である第二章主人公・上代蒼司に家庭教師をお願いすることに……。
「死」をテーマに絵を描く偏屈な父親のために、
村八分にされているお嬢様。
薄倖そうな外見の可憐さとは裏腹に、
感情豊かで怒りっぽいため、
いじめも何も、平気へっちゃら。
頭の回転は早いのだが勉強が苦手。
その成績は紙一重で低い……。
このままでは落第してしまうので、
「後輩」である２章主人公に家庭教師を頼むことになる。
かかしとアクセサリーが大好きなのだが、
ひまわりが大嫌い。

segments.text: "You are the only one for me, but you are..."
The object of her desire - Masaki Yoshikazu. A feeling of relief. A feeling of conviction. The relief and conviction of knowing that she is loved. She is constantly seeking these things.
"You will not allow anyone else into my heart, will you?"

She loves Yoshikazu so much to the point of not letting him go anywhere alone by himself. However, she is also quite jealous of the fact that his sister Akane is living with him and sometimes is provoking him about it.
Hobbies: Reading, Indoor activities such as watching movies
Likes: Masaki Yoshikazu
Dislikes: Masaki Akane
Basic Behavior: She is always right next to Yoshikazu, even when they take a bath.
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough
第三章主人公・柾木良和の恋人。
恋人である良和のことを一番に考え、その名の通り、彼の色に染まっていく透明な女性。
料理から洗濯まで家事は一通りこなせるが、性格の故かどれも際立っているということもない。可もなく不可もなく。
良和と仲のよい茜に、少なからず嫉妬を覚えているようだが……。
「……私にはあなただけ。でも、あなたは……」
求めて止まない対象──主人公。
そして、安心。確信。
自分が愛されている。
そんな安心と確信を、常に求めています。
──君は、君以外の人間を、僕の心に許さないのだろう？

segments.text: Nemu is Jun'ichi's adopted sister. She is actually in love with Jun'ichi and becomes mad when any other girl shows affection to him and uses "accidental" violence to stop the affection between him and another person. She wears a bell as an accessory, given to her by Jun'ichi when they were young. When her mood turns sour, she becomes excessively polite and antisocial, a condition that Jun'ichi calls "hidden Nemu". Her cooking is described as lethal, to the point that Jun'ichi quietly calls her the "Murderous Chef".
主人公と同じ誕生日、同い年の双子のクラスメイトと、ありえないような話だが……、実際のところは血が繋がっていない、子供のころに朝倉家に引き取られた少女。
家事万能にみせかけて、食事を作ると殺し屋が通販を申し込んできそうなまずい物を生み出す特殊な才能を持つ。
ちなみに、兄のずぼらさに頭を悩ませているが、そのずぼらさに胸をときめかせている節もある、多感なお年頃。
主人公の義理の妹。
兄さんの世話を焼くのが大好きなのだが、実は兄さんを頼りにしている世話のかかる妹。
二人とも、その掛け合いを楽しんでいる節も。
主人公・朝倉の義妹。
世話焼きだが、ヤキモチ焼きでもある。
現在は看護士を目指し、本島の看護学校へ通っている。
「兄さん……なんだか違う人みたい」
父母早年因车祸丧生，之后被朝仓家收养。
与纯一同一天出生，但称纯一为兄（「兄さん」）。因为身体虚弱，经常发热，所以纯一经常帮她检查体温。
在学校担任风纪委员，成绩优秀，性格活泼可爱，所以在学校很受欢迎。其料理水平实在不敢恭维，甚至连纯一也畏惧，因此多以便当与外卖解决，很少下厨。
非常在意纯一，对纯一抱有超越兄妹的感情，见到纯一跟其他女生一起会动用暴力镇压。也嫉妒纯一跟樱的关系，将樱在美国写给纯一的信全部丢掉。后前往护理学校实习。
几经波折,在D.C.S.S中的结局,因为纯一和她各自的情侣表而想起一切,后与纯一结婚.D.C II的故事以音梦与纯一结婚为基础，二代女主角朝仓音姬和朝仓由梦为纯一和音梦的孙女。

Jun'ichi's cousin and first love. She is a very lively girl who shows great affection towards Jun'ichi, much to Nemu's dismay. She is sometimes seen with Utamaru, a white cat. Actually older than Jun'ichi. She inherited her grandmother's magical ability, and despite the passing of several years, her appearance remains largely unchanged from what Jun'ichi and Nemu remember. Has an IQ of 180.
主人公と音夢の幼馴染で、従姉で、隣の家に住んでいた女の子。
六年前の春に海外に引っ越してしまったきり音信不通だったのだが、最近よく夢に現れては騒いでいなくなる迷惑極まりない存在……、夢だけど。
生来から甘えん坊で、お気楽極楽トンボな性格で、マスコットか珍獣のように可愛がられる。
主人公にベタ惚れしていて、義理の妹となった音夢に対抗して、主人公を「お兄ちゃん」と呼んでは 足や腰にへばりつく癖をもつ。
どのような成長を遂げたにしろ、再び出会う時に 主人公に訪れるのは、すごい迷惑か、ものすごい迷惑かのどちらかであろう……。
主人公の従姉にして、幼馴染でお兄ちゃん子。
甘えん坊でお気楽極楽な性格をしている。
珍獣かマスコット的な存在。
風見学園で講師を勤める天才少女。
朝倉のいとこで、感情表現が豊か。
IQ180を誇り、何でも完璧にこなすが、アメリカ帰りのためか、漢字の読み書きは苦手な様子。
「最初からボクのせいだったんだ！　ボクのせいでみんないなくなっちゃったんだよ!!」
立夏や清隆と深い縁で結ばれた女性。初音島や魔法について詳しい。
主人公と音夢の幼馴染。また従姉でもあり、隣の家に住んでいた女の子でもある。
６年前の春に海外に引っ越してしまったのだが、最近よく夢に現れては騒いでいなくなる迷惑極まりない存在……夢だけど。
生来から、甘えん坊でお気楽極楽トンボな性格で、 マスコットか珍獣のように可愛がられる。
主人公にベタ惚れしていて、義理の妹となった音夢に対抗して、主人公を「お兄ちゃん」と呼んでは 足や腰にへばりつく癖をもつ。
どのような成長を遂げたにしろ、再び出会う時に 主人公に訪れるのは、すごい迷惑か、ものすごい迷惑かのどちらかであろう……。
Kotori is the school's idol and star singer.
Although she can hear other people's thoughts, she carefully hides this ability.
She became close to Jun'ichi because he was the only one in the male student body that didn't try to idolize her. She has a habit of using cute greetings to people she feels especially close to.
誰にでもやさしく、容姿も美しく、高いカリスマ性を持つ学園のアイドル。
風見学園付属と本校の両方の学生に人気があり、実は非公認のファンクラブまであるとかないとか……。
立場的には高嶺の華のようだが、話をすると意外と茶目っ気のある笑顔を振り撒いてくれる、ミネラルウォーターのように清々しい少女なのだ。
帽子がチャームポイントで、趣味で集めてもいるらしい。
どこぞの田舎に、似たような趣味をもつ従姉の絵描きがいるようだが、にんともかんとも……。
美人で成績優秀、誰にでもやさしいという、絵に描いたような学園のアイドル。
意外と茶目っ気に溢れていて、話をすると面食らいながらも心が安らぐ不思議な少女。
風見学園本校2年生。
品行方正で成績優秀、容姿端麗で歌もうまく、学園ではアイドル的な扱いを受けている。
でも、本人はちょっぴりお茶目な普通の女の子。
品行方正、成績優秀、容姿端麗、歌唱力抜群で、学園のアイドル的存在。
しかしその正体は、ちょっぴりお茶目な普通の女の子だったりする。
「本当の恋人は、私なんだから…」

誰にでも優しく歌が上手くその上美人で成績も優秀な学園のアイドル。風見学園付属と本校の両方の学生から人気があり、非公式ファンクラブの存在さえ仄めかされる。近づきにくいように見えて話して見ると実は初対面の相手にも気さくに接するさわやかな少女である。チャームポイントである帽子は親からの薦めで所属している聖歌隊のものであり、帽子集めが趣味である。好きなものは甘い物全般、桜の花、オレンジジュース。人混み、犬、辛い物全般が苦手である。4人家族であり、純一のクラス3年1組の担任白河暦は義姉。

Moe is a gentle girl who is often seen throughout the series sitting on the roof at lunchtime cooking and eating nabe with her younger sister, Mako. She is very polite, but can be dim-witted at times, and can fall asleep anywhere at any time, even when she's walking. Sometimes she carries a small xylophone, although it's not because she wants to be a good player of said instrument. She is very knowledgeable about nabe, and can talk for hours about said subject.
In reality, the reason why she sleeps so often is due to her taking sleeping pills to see her deceased childhood friend, Keiichi, in her dreams.
風見学園本校生で、主人公や音夢たちの先輩にあたる少女。
ぼけぼけというか、ぽや～っとした天然色のお嬢様で、寝るのが好きというか、歩いている最中にもに寝てしまうこともしばしば……、ただしお裁縫などは、作業が遅いけど意外と得意。
鍋に一家言があるらしい。
音楽部に所属していて木琴を担当していたりと（腕はともかく）、朗らかな先輩。
あまりにも朗らかで、遅刻してしまい、誰もいない桜並木を木琴を叩きながら歩いているという不思議な姿も目撃 されている。
実は、彼女を知らない学生には学園七不思議に間違えられている節もあるとかないとか……。
彼女の妹である眞子は、全く逆の性格で、主人公のクラスメイトだとか。
学園七不思議に登録されているほど、寝ながら生活している先輩。
目を覚ましていても寝言のようなことしか言わないボケっぷりを発揮する。
おっとりポケポケした性格で、どこででも寝てしまう。
音楽部に所属しており、いつも携帯している木琴で、不思議な音色を奏でるのが得意。
「――大切な人を失った辛さ、私もよくわかりますから」
風見学園本校生で、主人公や音夢たちの先輩にあたる。
ぼけぼけというか、ぽや～っとした天然色のお嬢様で、寝るのが好き。というか、歩いている最中に寝てしまうこともしばしば……。ただしお裁縫などは、作業が遅いけど意外と得意。
音楽部で木琴を担当。しかし腕前は…？マーク。　あまりにもマイペースで、遅刻しているというのに、桜並木を木琴を叩きながら歩いているという不思議な姿も目撃されている。
彼女の妹水越眞子が主人公のクラスメイトにいるが、眞子はまったく逆の性格で、姉をフォローしている。
昼休みには妹と一緒に屋上でお鍋をつついているが、お鍋には一家言があるらしい。
Miharu is
an android patterned after
a childhood friend of the Asakura family
with the same name, and is thus experiencing lots of things for the first time
. Her enthusiasm often overrules her common sense
, and Jun'ichi often has to get her out of sight when her circuits start to overload
Like her namesake
, she enjoys eating bananas.
The real-life
Miharu adores Nemu, and behaves much like a little puppy around her.
通称は“わんこ”。
芳乃さくらが居なくなった後、朝倉兄妹の幼馴染になった少女。
特に音夢とは親友で、同じ委員会で“可愛がられて”いる。
無邪気な発言と忘れっぽい性格で、いつも主人公 をヤキモキさせるが、実は一番しっかりした性格をしている……、のかも。
主人公と音夢が義理の兄妹ということは知らず、二人の関係に夢見ているようなところもあるが、遠くから楽しく見守っている。
存在そのものが冗談のようなマッドサイエンティ ストの父を持つ。
意外と頑丈。バナナを愛している。
朝倉兄妹の幼馴染で音夢と同じ風紀委員に所属している後輩。
とにかく無邪気で、ニコニコと笑顔を振りまいている。
その姿はしっぽを振る「わんこ」。
朝倉兄妹の幼馴染で後輩。
明るくて元気、常に前向きなタイプだが、やや暴走気味な面も。
バナナを食べている時が、至福の時間らしい。
「そんな人を好きになった気持ちは、忘れちゃあ、ダメですよ」

Tamaki is the student of Kazami affiliated junior high class 3-1 and a miko at the local Shinto shrine. She inherited her mother's ability to see into the future. She first appears in Jun'ichi's class as a transfer student, declaring him to be her fiancé. She uses her archery skills to prevent people from getting hurt in foreseen accidents.
由緒正しき神社の娘で、巫女をしており、古風で凛とした雰囲気を持つ。
だが、時折、周囲の度肝を抜くような発言をすることも。
「私、朝倉様にお話していないこと、まだ一つあったんです」

Alice is a half-Japanese, half-northern-European. Having lost her parents at an early age, she lives with her butler, Seba, and several other helpers in a mansion on Hatsunejima. Incapable of speaking for herself or presenting her feelings, she communicates with others through her puppet Philos (ピロス Pirosu). Philos gets the ability to speak for Alice through the power of the magical sakura tree. Having spent time in a circus she has exceptional reflexes, but she is unable to swim. She is also good friends with Miharu who is in the same class as her, and Aisia who has came from the same region as she did.
朝倉の一つ下の後輩で、とびの色の瞳と銀髪が特徴。
物静かだが、運動が得意という一面もあり。
同級生である美春とは親友同士。
「先輩が、こんなに近くにいてくれるから、私は寂しくないです」

Just like Mikkun, Tomoko is part of a band led by Kotori, where she plays the bass guitar. She is a faithful friend who is always ready to help her bandmates, Kotori and Mikkun. But sometimes she acts like an airhead.
ことりの親友で音楽仲間。
あまり浮いた噂もなく、恋には奥手な様子。
でも奥手な分だけ、想像力は逞しいらしく一度広げた想像の翼は……。

A pianist in the band formed with Kotori and Tomoko, as well as their best friend. This girl has special feelings for her brother, which sometimes turns into erotic fantasies. So it's not surprising that her nickname "Mikkun" comes from the name of her brother, Mikihiko.
ことりの親友で、お兄ちゃんが大好きなちょっと困った女の子。
丁寧な口調でずばりと鋭いところを突いてくることも。
耳年増タイプでエッチな話題にも興味津々。
Now it's the cat's turn to be in a human skin. However, Yoriko used this chance to help her owner to get rid of her fears.
An angel who came down from heaven to study humans. But alas, her scatterbrained disposition leads to one failure after another.
She loves donuts with a fanatic passion, to the point that when she sees one, she can't think about anything else.
Birthday: Unknown
Likes: Donuts! D-O-N-U-T-S!
Dislikes: Big dogs
Hobby: Walking while eating donuts
Lead vocalist in Kaori's band, Dear.
She acts like the world revolves around her, and she despises anything which throws off her groove.

Her popularity owes a lot to her cutesy smile on TV appearances, but she has a ruthless personality, and sees every possible method of achieving her goals as a means to an end. She's boundlessly prideful, and is aiming to be a major artist.
Member of Dear, a popular idol group. Her singing abilities are widely acknowledged, but she doesn't particularly stand out in person, perhaps due to her reticent personality.
She doesn't fit in very well at school either, and spends a lot of time napping in the infirmary. Apparently, she can't sleep at all if she doesn't bring her own pajamas along.
Likes: Plushies her father gives her, singing
Dislikes: Carrots
Hobbies: Sleeping, skygazing, writing poetry
Computer-crazy girl, who loves fishing around the electronics shops for parts. Her skills as a programmer are formidable, and she's aiming to get a job at a major games company.

She met the protagonist at an electronics shop, and they immediately hit it off. In spite of her carefree personality, which often clashes with her surroundings, she's very close friends with the protagonist, almost as if they were made for each other.
Likes: Computers, junk food
Dislikes: Lightning (It's scary, and it screws up her machines)
Hobbies: Fishing for computer parts, programming
Another old friend of the protagonist, and the poster girl at the popular local cake shop, Orange Pekoe.

She's always been bosom buddies with the protagonist, and they can talk about seemingly anything. However, in recent days, she's been starting to get a strange sort of feeling that her attitude towards him is changing. All the same, she continues to spend her time every day with him as if it hasn't.
Likes: Her family's shop, the latest accessories
Dislikes: Mice (though she doesn't hate them so much as she's just scared of them)
Hobbies: Coming up with ideas for new types of donuts
A Chinese foreign exchange student. A master of eradication of malignant spirits and tai chi, she is hostile towards Ami, whom she views as "a mere phantom".
Always seen eating steamed buns.
Likes: Steamed buns, bustling places
Dislikes: Anything half-cocked
Hobbies: Tai chi, buying all different kinds of steamed buns
An angel who, just like Ami, came down from heaven to study humans.
In spite of being Ami's younger twin sister, her grades are significantly better. It wouldn't exactly be a reach for someone to mistake her for the older sister.
However, putting her greater academic strengths aside, she is every bit as big a sucker for donuts as Ami is.
Birthday: Unknown
Likes: Donuts, studying
Dislikes: Irresponsibility
Hobby: Savoring a nice cup of tea (with a compulsory donut on the side)
A disconcertingly impoverished girl, bereaved of both her parents and living on her own with her younger brother.

She holds numerous part-time jobs, originally starting out with one delivering milk. In spite of her miserable circumstances, her cheerful disposition gives her the drive to keep doing her best every day.
Incidentally, yakisoba bread is like haute cuisine to her.
Likes: Yakisoba bread, her brother Atsushi
Dislikes: Frogs (incredibly so)
Hobbies: Her numerous part-time jobs

actors.name: あおきさやか(青木静香)

segments.text: Suzue is a president of the class, in which Kanata now studies. She's smart, polite, refined, beautiful, and creates an impression of a girl every guy dreams about. But her smile is so naughty, depraved and so... sexy.
Visual stylist in Kaori's band, Dear.
She prefers not to meddle in others' affairs, and to do things her own way. While not aware of it herself, her appearance & general air of coolness tend to prove useful in winning others over.
She would never, ever admit it out loud, but she is slightly jealous of her bandmate Erika's restless & energetic lifestyle.

Mie is a loud, noisy and fussy girl. She has a sharp tongue and gets flustered easily. She is honest to herself and prone to argue. Also, she has developed very special feelings towards Souji ever since she met him one day at a field close to a mountain near Tokiwa village.
Hobbies: Cooking, karate, taking care of her siblings
Favorite: Starting a fight (especially with Sayaka)
Behavior: Noisy, loud, and fussy. Another girl who talks without thinking but also gets embarrassed easily. She usually says whatever is on her mind in open rather than hiding it.
Edited from MangaGamer and neo-X-saga's Walkthrough

Archimedes is a stuffed cat-like doll that Ojou carries around in her arms all the time. One of its strange abilities is that it is able to talk just like a normal human being albeit without opening its mouth. To a stranger, it appears like Ojou is using ventriloquism but that is not the case. It's not known why or how Archimedes is able to communicate with humans and its origin is certainly one big mystery. His main purpose appears to be that of Oujo's protector and a reliable traveling companion.

Suginami is Jun'ichi and Nemu's classmate and often gives Jun'ichi advice about relationships with girls. Although he is an excellent athlete, a top student, and good-looking, his oddly disturbing personality causes most people to keep their distance from him. He enjoys teasing Mako and dragging Jun'ichi into various situations.
Koyomi is Jun'ichi's homeroom teacher, one of the faculty's science teachers, and Kotori's older sister.
She is also a researcher at the Amakase Laboratory, and in charge of the android, Miharu.
Supposedly a cat. Her appearance is rather unusual, and she often moves by hopping rather than crawling. Sakura claims that she does not own Utamaru.

actors.name: あおきさやか(青木静香)

segments.text: Izumiko is an alien dressed in a pink bear suit which is actually a protective suit. While appearing by projection to most people as a "beautiful, slender girl with long black hair", Jun'ichi could never see this image and only sees her in a pink bear suit. Stranded on earth about 820 light years from home, she works part-time (amusingly, as a pink bear mascot) to support herself. Her name is actually only an alias, based on the names of the Japanese poets Murasaki Shikibu and Izumi Shikibu, and her real name is not known. Izumiko has no dialogue in either anime series but occasionally appears as a passerby.
